ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, $AC=BC$, points $D$ and $E$ are on $AB$ and $BC$ respectively, connecting $CD$ and $DE$. If $BC=BD$, $AC=2$, and $\angle CDE=45^\circ$, what is the length of $BE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \angle ACB=90^\circ$ and AC=BC,\\
$\therefore \angle A=\angle B=45^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle BDC=\angle CDE+\angle BDE=\angle A+\angle ACD$ and $\angle CDE=45^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BDE=\angle ACD$,\\
$\because BC=BD$,\\
$\therefore BD=AC$,\\
In $\triangle BDE$ and $\triangle ACD$,\\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle B=\angle A \\
BD=AC \\
\angle BDE=\angle ACD
\end{array}\right.$,\\
$\therefore \triangle BDE \cong \triangle ACD$ (ASA),\\
$\therefore BE=AD$,\\
$\because BC=AC=2$ and $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore AB =\sqrt{AC^2+BC^2}=\sqrt{2^2+2^2}=2\sqrt{2}$,\\
$\because BD=BC=2$,\\
$\therefore AD=AB-BD=2\sqrt{2}-2$,\\
$\therefore BE=\boxed{2\sqrt{2}-2}$.

先描述图像：附图中，△ABC 的底边 AB 水平，A 在左端，B 在右端，C 在上方；D 位于 AB 上，E 位于 CB 上；图中连接了 CD 和 DE，并且从 D 指向 E 的线段位于从 D 指向 C 的线段下方。
再推理：按坐标/三角法处理。因为 ∠ACB=90° 且 AC=BC=2，所以 △ABC 是直角等腰三角形，AB=2√2。取 A=(0,0)，B=(2√2,0)，C=(√2,√2)。又因为 BD=BC=2，且 D 在 AB 上，所以 D=(2√2-2,0)。设 E 在 BC 上，令 E=B+t(C-B)，0<t<1，则 E=((2-t)√2,t√2)，并且 BE=t·BC=2t。从 D 到 C 的向量为 C-D=(2-√2,√2)，其斜率为 √2/(2-√2)=√2+1=tan 67.5°，所以 DC 的方向角是 67.5°。由图可见 DE 是从 D 出发较低的那条射线，且 ∠CDE=45°，所以 DE 的方向角为 67.5°-45°=22.5°，斜率为 tan 22.5°=√2-1。另一方面，DE 的斜率为 t√2/(2-t√2)。因此 t√2/(2-t√2)=√2-1。解得 t=√2-1，所以 BE=2t=2√2-2。

planner_metadata.image_role: Use the image to choose a coordinate orientation with AB horizontal, C above AB, D between A and B, and E on the segment from B to C; also use the visual fact that ray DE lies below ray DC, so the direction angle of DE is 45° less than that of DC.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the textual givens AC=BC=2, ∠ACB=90°, BD=BC, and ∠CDE=45° to determine coordinates and the angle condition.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use coordinate geometry for a 45-45-90 triangle, parametrization of a point on a segment, slope as tangent of direction angle, tan 67.5°=√2+1, tan 22.5°=√2−1, and algebraic solving.

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, within $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$, $AC=BC$, points $D$ and $E$ are on $AB$ and $BC$ respectively, connecting $CD$ and $DE$. If $BC=BD$, $AC=2$, and $\angle CDE=45^\circ$, what is the length of $BE$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \angle ACB=90^\circ$ and AC=BC,\\
$\therefore \angle A=\angle B=45^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle BDC=\angle CDE+\angle BDE=\angle A+\angle ACD$ and $\angle CDE=45^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BDE=\angle ACD$,\\
$\because BC=BD$,\\
$\therefore BD=AC$,\\
In $\triangle BDE$ and $\triangle ACD$,\\
$\left\{\begin{array}{l}
\angle B=\angle A \\
BD=AC \\
\angle BDE=\angle ACD
\end{array}\right.$,\\
$\therefore \triangle BDE \cong \triangle ACD$ (ASA),\\
$\therefore BE=AD$,\\
$\because BC=AC=2$ and $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore AB =\sqrt{AC^2+BC^2}=\sqrt{2^2+2^2}=2\sqrt{2}$,\\
$\because BD=BC=2$,\\
$\therefore AD=AB-BD=2\sqrt{2}-2$,\\
$\therefore BE=\boxed{2\sqrt{2}-2}$
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the attached figure, a triangle ABC can be seen, with A at the lower left, B at the lower right, and C above; D is located on the base AB, and E is located on the side CB; CD and DE are connected in the figure. From the figure it can be read that A, D, B are collinear, E is on CB, and CD and DE are inside the triangle.
Reasoning: It is known that ∠ACB=90° and AC=BC, and also AC=2, so BC=2. Because △ABC is an isosceles right triangle, ∠A=∠B=45°. D is on AB, therefore DB and AB are on the same straight line, and ∠BDC is the exterior angle of △ACD at point D, so ∠BDC=∠A+∠ACD. On the other hand, from the figure DE is inside ∠BDC, ∠BDC=∠CDE+∠BDE. It is known that ∠CDE=45°, and ∠A=45°, so ∠BDE=∠ACD. It is also known that BC=BD, and BC=AC, so BD=AC. In △BDE and △ACD, ∠B=∠A, BD=AC, ∠BDE=∠ACD, therefore △BDE≅△ACD (ASA). So the corresponding sides BE=AD. Because AC=BC=2 and ∠ACB=90°, by the Pythagorean theorem AB=√(2²+2²)=2√2. Also BD=BC=2, so AD=AB−BD=2√2−2. Therefore BE=2√2−2.
